instruction: Identify the sales representative with the highest total sales across all six months and highlight their entire row with any background color.

metadata.explanation: Task requires identifying the sales rep with highest total sales and highlighting their row. Verified with Python: Calculated total sales for all reps - Kandice Hussey (row 10) has the highest total of 3000 (752+773+483+220+597+175). Custom getter detects highlighted rows, custom metric checks if row 10 is highlighted.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter logic is correct: Reads Excel file, checks rows 2-12 for fill colors, returns list of highlighted row indices
Metric logic is correct: Receives highlighted rows list, checks if expected row 10 is present, returns binary score
Expected value is correct: Row 10 (Kandice Hussey) verified to have highest total sales (3000) via Python calculation
Coverage is complete: Evaluator verifies both requirements - identifying correct sales rep (row 10) and checking if row is highlighted
Postconfig is appropriate: Saves file with Ctrl+S to persist highlighting changes before getter reads the file
Data flow is semantically correct: User highlights row → file saved → getter detects highlighting → metric verifies row 10 highlighted
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Minor edge case: Getter excludes white (FFFFFFFF) and black (FF000000) fills from highlighting detection. While reasonable, instruction says 'any background color' so technically these should count. Consider if this edge case matters for your use case.
